question: Does the SOP TRAIN matched-mode final-block gain transfer to unseen CUB-200-2011 classes without CUB fitting?
population: CUB-200-2011 official classes 101-200 test identity split, all 5,924 images in self-retrieval gallery with query self excluded; no CUB fitting; this transfer panel has been inspected in earlier experiments, so it is exploratory
arms: the frozen SOP TRAIN head_arcface checkpoint and the SOP TRAIN tail_arcface_eval checkpoint; same UNICOM B/16 architecture, 224-pixel canonical preprocessing, 128-dimensional compact head, 130-byte signed-int8/f16 packed scorer, ordinal tie break
metrics: paired per-query packed Recall@1 and mAP@R primary, float 128-D auxiliary; record image-byte manifest, feature digests, encoder/scorer wall times, CUDA allocated peak and host RSS
gate: advance the frozen tail checkpoint to exploratory Cars196 transfer only if its CUB packed Recall@1 and mAP@R are each at least the matched head checkpoint point estimate; otherwise stop this SOP-trained tail candidate and diagnose cross-dataset forgetting; no post-result threshold changes
next_if_pass: CUB/Cars transfer and live JPEG-to-encoder versus cached-token descriptor parity precede three-seed and larger unseen-gallery confirmation; no official SOP or In-Shop quality claim from this gate
